books.title: The Little Boat
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A little boat sails on the sea. Its name is Sunny.
The wind blows the sail. Sunny goes fast over the waves.
Sunny sees a dolphin. The dolphin jumps out of the water.
Sunny sails past a sandy island. The palm trees wave in the wind.
At sunset Sunny sails home. It was a very good day.

books.title: Max and the Moon
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Max looks out of his window. The moon is big and round.
Max waves at the moon. 'Hello, Moon!' he says.
The moon shines on Max's bed. Max feels safe and warm.
Max closes his eyes. He dreams of flying to the moon.
In the morning Max wakes up. He says, 'Thank you, Moon.'

books.title: The Big Cake
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Today is Sara's birthday. Mum bakes a big cake.
The cake has pink icing and six candles. It looks so good.
Sara's friends come to the party. They sing a birthday song.
Sara blows out the candles. She makes a secret wish.
Everyone eats the cake. It is sweet and soft. Happy birthday, Sara!

books.title: The Funny Monkey
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A funny monkey lives in a big tree. His name is Milo.
Milo swings from branch to branch. Whee!
Milo sees a yellow banana. He grabs it fast.
Milo peels the banana. He eats it all up. Yum!
Then Milo sleeps in his tree. What a fun day!
